[Section] Sensational Headline Generation ::: Dataset
[source_id=37] We use LCSTS BIBREF5 as our dataset to train the summarization model. The dataset is collected from the Chinese microblogging website Sina Weibo. It contains over 2 million Chinese short texts with corresponding headlines given by the author of each text. The dataset is split into 2,400,591 samples for training, 10,666 samples for validation and 725 samples for testing. We tokenize each sentence with Jieba and a vocabulary size of 50000 is saved.
